surfaces.summary: Close required internal blockers: crash evidence automation, second execution slot scheduling, packaged long-running service mode, full heavy resource stress, and Android-side package installation. P13-05 now includes simulated native fatal running-marker collection, real fatal native SIGKILL chaos collection, packaged launch-surface marker contract, passing packaged APK crash smoke, and native signal-safe fixed-size marker proof. P13-06 now includes default two-slot scheduling, descriptor/package processPoolSlot metadata, explicit packaged overflow-slot smoke coverage, pool-busy diagnostics, no-restart crash marker fallback evidence, and focused primary/overflow shared-resource stress while long-duration P13-08 soak remains open. P13-09 now includes a source-authority-aware guarded local mutation package_manager facade for status/policy/sourcePolicy/planInstall/planUpdate/planRemove/install/update/remove/list/verify/prune while registry download, npm CLI, signed native payloads, and distribution integration remain open.
surfaces.rollback: Disable the promoted runtime path by profile flag and keep one-shot primary embedded execution as the fallback.

P13-19 records partial accessibility selector evidence while advanced gesture, packaged service, and root/Shizuku tiers remain blocked. surfaces.summary: Expand Pro-style tasks, Intent/broadcast triggers, app/intent helpers, shell/root/Shizuku, notifications/settings, media/recorder/mediainfo, and utility-heavy Rhino modules. P13-21 records partial daily/weekly/user task database provider evidence: live work_manager and compat.tasks one-shot migration are available, while daily/weekly task database add/query/update/remove, packaged task rows, scheduler semantics, and raw TimedTask/IntentTask profile decisions remain blocked. P13-22 records partial IntentTask/broadcast provider evidence: Android/Rhino receiver substrate and compat.tasks rejection stubs are available, while receiver capability split, manifest synthesis, trigger payloads, packaged install/trigger/remove, exported policy, and raw Intent/BroadcastReceiver profile decisions remain blocked. P13-23 records partial app/intent/broadcast parity: JSON-safe app.intent descriptors, stricter app.startActivity descriptor parsing, URL/email/settings/uninstall helpers, exact app.query installed-app lookups, scoped file view/edit helpers, and app.launch alias parity are available, while sendBroadcast, root/Shizuku app options, dual-user helpers, raw installed-app list APIs, and packaged smoke remain blocked. P13-24 records partial shell/root/Shizuku capability evidence: shell.root and shell.shizuku are explicit capability tokens, execRoot routes through the controlled shell bridge, and execShizuku is a stable rejection while real root/Shizuku device and packaged evidence remain blocked. P13-25 records partial notifications/settings/power manager evidence: notification permission/settings snapshots and battery-optimization status/settings dry-run helpers are available behind explicit notifications.settings and device.power capabilities while actions/listeners/wakelocks/direct power control and packaged evidence remain blocked. P13-26 records partial media/recorder/mediainfo provider evidence: read-only audio stream snapshots, scoped mediainfo metadata, recorder status, and compat aliases are available behind exact media.audio/media.metadata/media.recording capabilities while playback, real recording, MediaStore, packaged media evidence, and migration examples remain blocked. P13-27 records partial utility-heavy Rhino modules evidence: pure jsox.mathx helpers are available through jsox, jsox.mathx, and compat.jsox while zip, canvas, OpenCC/pinyin packaged resources, sysprops, Arrayx, Numberx, and raw Canvas/Paint or Android/OpenCV object parity remain blocked.
runtimeSurface: notifications settings and device power manager
surfaces.rollback: Keep P12 stable unsupported or blocked_by_design stubs and require explicit migration to supported Node bridge modules.

surfaces.summary: Create Node builtin parity matrix and stage desktop network and filesystem expansion: P13-29 records controlled http/https client parity as partial; P13-30 records limited net/tls/dns facades as partial; P13-31 records dgram/UDP as stable-denied; P13-32 records Safe filesystem profile diagnostics; P13-33 records scoped advanced fs APIs as partial while real sockets, network DNS, TLS sessions, broader roots, and full desktop fs semantics remain staged.
surfaces.rollback: Revert Desktop profile allowlist entries and keep raw network and broad filesystem access denied.

surfaces.summary: Stage desktop execution capabilities: P13-34 records worker_threads opt-in diagnostics and native-preflight evidence as partial; P13-35 records process-worker replacement as WorkerPool-preferred with no new process_worker facade while child_process remains denied by default; P13-36 records native vm availability while memory/compiled-script budgets, timeout/lifecycle stress, and packaged VM evidence remain open; P13-37 records inspector debug-profile diagnostics while keeping inspector denied until explicit debug session UI, loopback ADB forwarding, DevTools attach, profiler redaction, and packaged behavior evidence exists; P13-38 records controlled WASI diagnostics while keeping raw WASI denied until scoped preopen, fd/env/args, resource, worker, and packaged behavior evidence exists; P13-39 records native addon diagnostics while keeping .node, process.dlopen, native builds, and download-exec denied until signed packaged artifacts, ABI/hash allowlists, dependency scan, and crash isolation exist; P13-40 records child_process scoped-runner diagnostics plus a release-forbidden debug/native opt-in via autojs.nodejs.child_process.experimental=true while keeping child_process denied by default and shell as a separate scoped bridge until app-private allowlisted binaries, bounded stdio, cancel/kill/cleanup, packaged evidence, and hostile corpus exist.
surfaces.rollback: Disable desktop execution flags and keep high-risk builtins on stable denial paths.

surfaces.summary: Improve desktop module and process parity: P13-41 records partial ESM loader diagnostics with full raw-loader parity still blocked; P13-42 records Android package-manager substrate diagnostics with host-managed npm plus local app-private Android store partial, source-authority policy, guarded local mutation package_manager facade for status/policy/sourcePolicy/planInstall/planUpdate/planRemove/planRegistryInstall/planTarballInstall/install/update/remove/list/verify/prune, plan-only remote source boundary diagnostics with caller-provided packument dist-tag/semver/integrity resolution and local tarball URL/name/version/sha512 preflight, and a guarded npm alias facade while npm CLI, registry download, lifecycle scripts, bin/native execution, and unrestricted install authority remain blocked; P13-43 records stdlib conformance as partial with representative Safe subset modules, Android difference notes, matrix/corpus/differential evidence, and fail-closed desktop gaps; P13-44 records process/env/argv parity as partial with processParityProfile, focused argv/env/cwd/timing/resource/report/permission evidence, and stable denials for raw exit, signals, native bindings, raw env inheritance, raw process handles, and full desktop process parity.
